headline: Korea Local Government Finance Mutual Aid Association's Alternative Investments Raise Alarm... 53.9 Billion Won Principal, 32.8 Billion Won Lost
summary: The association recorded losses of over 30 billion won over five years from some alternative investments. It had 53.9 billion won of principal, of which 32.8 billion won was lost.
why: The association manages funds for local governments and public institutions, so losses on alternative investments affect public-sector finances.
